headline_marked: [[XREAL Aura smart glasses launch]] with Android XR, starting at $1099 for a limited time
headline: XREAL Aura smart glasses launch with Android XR, starting at $1099 for a limited time
summary: The new wired XR glasses run Google's Android XR and are available now with up to $200 off the base price. They feature a lightweight design with a separate computing puck and integrated Gemini AI.
details: XREAL has officially launched its new Aura smart glasses, now available for purchase. The base model, featuring 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, starts at $1,279, but a limited-time launch price offers it for $1,099.

There's also a higher-end model with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, originally priced at $1,499, now discounted by $200. These discounts make the advanced technology more accessible to early adopters.

The XREAL Aura are wired XR glasses powered by Google's Android XR platform, which is slowly seeing more products emerge since its debut a year ago. They aim to provide an immersive content experience without fully enveloping the user.

The device consists of two main parts: the glasses, which house the displays, and a separate 'puck' containing the computing hardware and battery. This design ensures the glasses remain light and comfortable for extended wear, preventing discomfort like headaches.

Both the glasses' arms and the computing puck feature touch controls for easy interaction. Running Android XR, the Aura offers a familiar yet distinct user experience, enhanced by integrated access to Gemini AI for seamless interactions.
